packages.name: Implement feature
packages.description: Plan and implement a requested feature in the current project using its existing architecture, conventions, and tests.

packages.name: Fix bug
packages.description: Reproduce, diagnose, and fix a bug or regression in the current project with a minimal evidence-based change.

packages.name: Review code
packages.description: Review current code changes for correctness, regressions, security, maintainability, and missing tests.

packages.name: Write tests
packages.description: Add or improve focused automated tests for the current project using its existing test framework and conventions.

packages.name: Explain code
packages.description: Explain how the current project works using evidence from its code, contracts, data flow, and tests.

packages.name: Create skill
packages.description: Create Agent Skills with valid SKILL.md structure, clear scope, useful instructions, and deterministic validation.

packages.name: Goal
packages.description: Keep working a long-lived chat objective until it is complete. Use when the user sets /goal or asks to persist until an outcome is done. Pair with /loop. Never pause yourself.

packages.name: Frontend design
packages.description: Design and implement UI layout, hierarchy, motion, and brand-facing screens without generic clutter.

packages.name: Accessibility
packages.description: Audit and improve UI accessibility: semantic HTML, keyboard, focus, contrast, screen-reader names, and motion preferences.

packages.name: API design
packages.description: Design or change HTTP, IPC, and SDK API contracts, schemas, errors, and versioning.

packages.name: Persona builder
packages.description: Draft a custom agent persona and tone for Agent V within the settings limits, confirm with you, and hand over paste-ready text for Settings.
